what_it_does: Studies how data centers can optimally size and compose on-site microgrids—systems that combine solar panels, wind turbines, battery storage, and the local compute workload. The goal is to minimize both the carbon emissions from running the data center and the carbon cost of manufacturing and installing all that renewable equipment. The work extends Vessim, an existing simulation tool that co-simulates computing workloads and power generation together, using solar and wind models from the National Renewable Energy Laboratory.
